# Four Exercise Demonstration Scenarios

Owner-supplied ZIP, 2026-10-23. SHA256:
`9cae2611060cfc9637a8f58f017fc7bb0ed3813398a2be90e1bfdb18313c3fe7`.
All 21 files listed in the supplied SHA256SUMS.txt verified before copying.
The original archive was not changed; none of its authoring scripts were run.

Copied unaltered: four GLBs, MIT license notice, asset manifest and supplied
contact/scenario checks. Previews and authoring code remain in the original ZIP.
Exact GLB sizes are in asset_manifest.json; pinned SHA256 values are also in
`ui-preview/demo-review-clips.mjs` and checked by the focused asset test.

All scenes contain their own skinned human and barbell on one shared timeline.
No external resources or required extensions. +Y up, metres, face -Z. Use the
complete scene and one mixer; no independent bar animation or cross-fades.
Authored clips last 5.3 seconds, uniformly retimed to six-second UI cycles.

Variants: intended correct squat, predefined excessive-forward-lean squat,
intended correct conventional deadlift, predefined spinal-rounding deadlift.
These examples are selected by the user, not diagnosed by the binary classifier.
No geometry is used as model input. No model, labels or threshold changes.

These are AI-assisted, custom constraint-based review prototypes, not mocap or
biomechanically validated references. Supplied contact/scenario metrics are
author evidence, not our independent full-body collision/biomechanics checks.
Keep LICENSE.txt with any distribution. Prior Review 01 assets remain preserved.
